slides.title: I need lots of money
slides.head: Many people start small.
slides.body: Begin with what you already have and spend only when you must.

slides.title: I need a perfect plan
slides.head: A one page plan is enough to begin.
slides.body: Who you help, what you offer, what it costs.

slides.title: Good work sells itself
slides.head: People can only buy what they can find.
slides.body: Tell people what you do and make it easy to contact you.

slides.title: Lower prices win customers
slides.head: Price too low and you cannot keep going.
slides.body: Work out your costs first, then price so you make something.

slides.title: I must do it all alone
slides.head: Ask for advice early.
slides.body: Other owners, suppliers and customers can all teach you something.
